control_record.method: make perf LABEL=adhoc (the reference hamlet at seeds 4, 25, 39, 47) in a detached worktree at origin/main 80af74aef - feature 280 and the rest of main, without feature 287's placement guarantees - two runs alternated with the clone's HEAD at load 2.6-3.0: 24.4 s and 24.3 s

explanation: The reference snapshot grew 20.9 s -> 27.7 s (+32.5%). About half is main's own work since 287 began, merged in (feature 280's fixture forms and larger yards among it): main without 287 reads 24.35 s on the same host. The rest, ~3.2 s (+13% over main), is feature 287's guarantees doing placement work the old placers skipped and a re-roll papered over: the access tree judged at seating for every candidate seat (homesteads +0.5-1.5 s a seed), the lane web settled to the lane law with the tree's corridors drawn and pruned (web +0.5-1.4 s), the overlap registry asked by every writer, the belt settled deep and whole and the woodland lots cut to their bounds (hinterland +0.5 s), and the field fit's legality with 287's sluice position moving seed 25's fan to 13 carves (field +1.2 s). Two recovery passes indexed every per-candidate scan found (35 s -> 27.7 s, maps byte-identical); the residue is spread thin across the guaranteed seating's per-offer cost. The one measured remaining lever, full-pitch-first seat offers, changes the hamlets' form (clusters 12-27% looser, up to 28% taller) and was declined; dropping the straggler footpaths is unmeasured.
